lastCompletedStory.title: Add rewriteFrontmatterEffort + wire into save, sync agent files and re-embed

nextStoryContext: US-002 landed the effort frontmatter writer end-to-end (helper + wiring + agent-file sync), but NOT the wizard UI step. `src/templates/frontmatter.ts` now exports `rewriteFrontmatterEffort(content, newEffort)` (rewrites an existing `effort:` line via the same scoped-regex approach as `rewriteFrontmatterModel`, and ALSO inserts the line just inside the closing `---` fence when absent -- string-in/string-out, no fs) plus its own `FRONTMATTER_TARGET_EFFORT_PATHS: Record<LlmPhase, string>` map pointing at `.claude/agents/subagent-<phase>.md` for the 5 LLM phases (orchestrator/planner/auditor/implementer/reviewer), deliberately distinct from `FRONTMATTER_TARGET_PHASE_PATHS` (ship-only, `.claude/commands/cam-ship.md`). `src/commands/config.ts` gained `rewriteFrontmatterEfforts(cwd, choices)`, wired into `mergeConfigChoices` right after `rewriteFrontmatterModels` when `cwd` is provided and `choices.efforts` is defined; it resolves each of the 5 paths relative to cwd and silently skips missing files, mirroring the model helper exactly. `.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md` (+ its `templates/agents/` twin) gained `effort: high`; `.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md` (+twin) was bumped `high` -> `xhigh`. `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run so `src/vendor/_generated.ts` reflects both templates/agents/ edits (embed-vendor:check is clean). REMAINING GAP (per US-001's handoff, still not closed): ConfigScreen.tsx's wizard still does NOT collect `choices.efforts` -- there is no per-LLM-phase effort-picking WizardStep, so in production `mergeConfigChoices` is always called with `choices.efforts === undefined` and neither the TOML `[efforts]` write (US-001) nor this story's frontmatter rewrite ever fires from the live `cam config` wizard today; both are fully unit-tested and wired, just unreachable from the interactive path until a future story adds the UI step and threads it into `onDone()`'s choices object (ConfigScreen.tsx ~line 304-330, see `PhaseStepsSection`/`useFireOnDone` for the existing per-phase-model precedent to mirror). Do not add `ship` to any effort map or `LlmPhase`-typed structure (ADR-0009: ship is deterministic, zero LLM calls, no effort concept).
